name: extract_links
description:
All hyperlinks (<a href>) on one web page, marked internal or external.
Returns {url, links: [{url, is_internal, is_absolute}], link_count, internal_count, external_count, extracted_at}.
Inputs (* required): url* (string, absolute http(s) URL), normalize (boolean, default true: relative links made absolute, unusable ones dropped), internal_only (boolean, default false: keep only same-domain links), render_js (boolean: run JavaScript first, when enabled).
To follow the links as well use crawl_url; for a site's listed pages crawl_sitemap.
Example: {"url": "https://docs.python.org/3/", "internal_only": true}

url.description: URL of the page to extract links from

normalize.description: Convert relative URLs to absolute URLs (recommended: true)

render_js.description: Run the page's JavaScript in a headless browser first; only when the operator enabled tools.webcrawler.javascript, and every request the page makes still passes the outbound guard

url.description: Link URL (absolute or relative based on normalize setting)

is_internal.description: Whether link points to same domain

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Extracts all <a href> links from HTML. Useful for navigation analysis, broken link checking, and understanding site structure.

examples.description: Extract all links with absolute URLs
